description: This Kotlin source file defines a UI screen for rendering a 2D scatter plot of RadarPoint data as a custom Android View within a Jetpack Compose application. It includes a composable function for embedding the view, a custom View class for drawing points, and methods for setting data and rendering the plot on Canvas.

classes.name: Scatter2DView
classes.description: A custom Android View that renders a 2D scatter plot of points provided via setPoints(), handling drawing circles scaled according to point intensity.

methods.name: Plot2DScreen
methods.description: A composable function that embeds the Scatter2DView into a Compose layout, updating it with a list of RadarPoint objects.

methods.name: setPoints
methods.description: Sets the list of RadarPoint objects to be plotted and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overridden method that calculates coordinate mapping and renders all points as circles with radius scaled by intensity.
